findings.claim: The new entry says A1-2 'autoriza separadamente `sense run --write --publish` sob ensaio de não publicação e não escrita em `record/`' but never says this consent covers only the ephemeral CI job. For `sense record --write`, the same sentence does say 'apenas ao job efêmero'. Read on its own, this historical record leaves A1-2b looking as if it could cover the maestro running on the real repository. That is the ambiguity finding 1 of cycle 1 fixed in the contract. The binding sections of plan.md (line 331 and M15, lines 424-431) do restrict it to the ephemeral job, so this is a local imprecision and does not make anything eligible to run.
